items.title: Josh Jacobs: Limited at Sunday's practice
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) was listed as limited at Sunday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN reports.

items.title: DJ Moore: Second straight game with TD
items.text:
Moore caught eight of 10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: James Cook: Extends TD streak to nine games
items.text:
Cook rushed 22 times for 89 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: Josh Allen: Just one TD, zero rushing yards in win
items.text:
Allen completed 27 of 45 passes for 304 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Goes to medical tent late
items.text:
Coker was taken to the medical tent late in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens to be evaluated for an injury, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Derrick Henry: Being checked for concussion
items.text:
